segments.context: Onyx Coffee Lab · United StatesEclipseEclipse is the clearest Onyx trial when the usual drink needs a deliberately developed, roast-led coffee rather than Geometry's brighter café espresso or Monarch's fruit-rich dark blend. Onyx's current page names washed Colombian Caturra and publishes both a 20 g to 47 g espresso start and a French-press recipe, but it also says the origin rotates. A small dated bag is more useful than treating today's component record or other owners' bitterness preference as permanent.Updated 2026-11-11 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 11, 2026

Stumptown Coffee Roasters · United StatesHomesteadHomestead is a small-bag trial for a buyer who wants Stumptown's lightest blend direction in daily drip or press, with chocolate and candied fruit in the roaster's brief. The current page identifies rotating Latin American and East African components but does not fix farms, varieties or proportions. Use the published filter method and the actual roast date rather than assuming an older owner's espresso result will transfer to your machine.Updated 2026-11-11 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 11, 2026

segments.context: Intelligentsia Coffee · United StatesOrganic Black Cat EspressoOrganic Black Cat is the Black Cat trial for a buyer who wants certified organic espresso with a black-cherry, cacao and spice brief rather than Analog's darker milk-oriented chocolate direction. The current official record names washed Ethiopian and Guatemalan components and an 18 g to 45 g espresso start. Older indexed records and owner accounts describe different bags, so the actual current package date and component panel matter more than a family-name assumption.Updated 2026-11-11 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 11, 2026
